verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a GraphQL platform API (monday-docs-35) and an OpenAPI spec endpoint, but nothing shows API version identifiers, version pinning, or a published deprecation policy. The "promote versions" mention (monday-docs-17) concerns app deployment versions, not API versioning, so it is an adjacent feature. Community items are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
